subject: Pen test delivery and redaction plan for contract review
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@atlashealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Atlas Health Security Team <security@atlashealth.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test evidence required for contract approval

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. We’re in late-stage procurement for the Redwood Dedicated pilot and our procurement team is asking for a copy of your most recent external penetration test report (or a redacted executive summary) as part of our security gating checklist. We need to close our review by next Wednesday, 13 May, to meet our vendor onboarding window.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide:
- a redacted external pen test report (PII/keys removed), or
- a signed attestation that the test scope covered internet-facing endpoints and auth flows, and
- a remediation matrix showing open findings and status?

If there are any NDAs or additional steps you require before sharing full findings, let us know — procurement is willing to sign. This is blocking PO approval for deal ATL-2026-042.

Thanks,
Olivia

Olivia Barnes
Head of Vendor Security
Atlas Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test evidence required for contract approval

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline.

Short answer: yes. We can share a redacted pen test report and a remediation matrix. We typically provide a redacted PDF that removes sensitive payloads, IP-level indicators, and any customer-specific artifacts, plus an XLSX remediation tracker that shows severity, status, and expected closure window.

Two quick notes:
1) We do require a standard mutual NDA before releasing the unredacted findings to external vendor security teams. If Atlas is comfortable with a redacted copy that removes exploit details, we can share immediately.
2) Our security team is currently finishing a follow-up validation on medium findings and can mark status in the remediation matrix; where work is still in progress we’ll include ETA and owner.

I’ve looped in Mina (security) and Dev (legal) to confirm scope of redactions and to send the NDA if needed. I’ll aim to get the redacted package to you by Tuesday EOD (12 May) so your team has a full day before your deadline.

Would you prefer the redacted package by email or a secure Drive link?

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test evidence required for contract approval

Rishi — quick internal note on scope/redaction:

- Recommended redaction level: remove PoC payloads, exploit scripts, internal IPs, and exact timestamps tied to customer environments. Keep vulnerability titles, affected components (e.g., auth endpoint, control-plane API), severity, and high-level remediation notes.
- Confirmed scope of the most recent test: external network + public API auth flows; no customer data stores were included. We can state that explicitly in an accompanying cover letter.
- Remediation status: two high findings were closed as of 2026-05-05; three medium findings are in progress with ETAs between 2026-05-20 and 2026-05-28. I’ll prepare the remediation matrix with owner and ETA columns.

I’ll also attach the NDA template for signature if Atlas wants the unredacted report.

— Mina
Principal Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test evidence required for contract approval

Olivia — attaching the redacted package per your request.

Attachments: pen_test_report_v2_redacted.pdf (redacted external pen test report), remediation_matrix_ATL042.xlsx (status and ETAs), NDA_signed_ATL.pdf (mutual NDA signed by Redwood — please countersign if you want the full report).

Summary:
- Test scope: external attack surface & public API auth flows (confirmed).
- Redaction: PoC content, exploit scripts, internal IP ranges removed.
- Remediation brief: 2 high findings closed (as of 2026-05-05), 3 medium findings in remediation with target closure between 2026-05-20 and 2026-05-28.

If you need anything further or would like a 20–30 minute walkthrough between your security team and Mina to talk through findings, we can schedule it tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Thanks — received and shared with procurement/security. The redacted report and remediation matrix look good at a glance. Procurement will accept the redacted copy for PO approval; Atlas Legal will countersign the NDA and return it if we need the unredacted report.

Two quick asks:
- Could Mina join a 30-minute sync with our security lead on Thursday 14 May at 10:00 PT to go over the medium findings?
- Can you add an explicit line in the remediation matrix about whether retest/validation has been scheduled for each finding?

If you can confirm both, we should be able to get the PO over the finish line by 14 May.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olivia
